cases.customer_question: Can we provide antenna gain values including cable loss, and should the loss be based on the product cable or measurement cable for Bluetooth RF testing?
question_variants: Is it acceptable to submit antenna + cable loss instead of antenna-only gain?
Can total RF path loss be used when antenna-only data is unavailable?
Should cable loss in RF test documentation refer to product cable or measurement cable?
What value should be entered if antenna gain alone is not measured?
For Bluetooth RF test plans, can we use measurement cable loss values?
cases.actual_issue: How to correctly report antenna-related RF parameters when standalone antenna gain is unavailable, specifically whether combined antenna and cable loss values are acceptable and which cable loss (product vs measurement setup) should be used.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer does not have a clean antenna-only measurement and instead has a combined value that includes cable loss. They are unsure if this is acceptable for Bluetooth RF testing and which cable’s loss should be documented. This matters because incorrect RF parameters can affect test validity and interpretation.
cases.consultant_answer: It is acceptable to provide a combined value that includes both antenna and cable loss when antenna-only data is not available. For the purpose of RF test documentation and planning, the loss value should be based on the measurement setup cable rather than the product’s internal antenna cable. If BLE test mode details are not yet finalized, the value can be temporarily marked as TBD and updated later.
cases.decision_logic: RF test documentation prioritizes practical measurement conditions. When antenna-only gain is unavailable, total path loss is acceptable as long as it reflects the actual test setup. Measurement cable loss is preferred because it directly impacts conducted RF test accuracy.
cases.final_recommendation: Submit the combined antenna + cable loss value using the measurement cable loss. Mark any unknown parameters (e.g., BLE test mode details) as TBD and update them once finalized.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Using incorrect cable loss (e.g., product cable instead of measurement cable) can lead to inaccurate RF test results, potential test failures, or the need to repeat RF testing due to inconsistent or non-representative data.
search_aliases: RF cable loss measurement vs product cable
